description: Points d'eau en libre accès is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Talence. Points d'eau en libre accès sur la commune de Talence. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Eau et assainissement. Its keywords are Points d'eau, libre, canicule, chaleur. The portal shows 11 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-07-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
